title: 30-Day Standard Return Policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are in original packaging and undamaged condition. Customers are provided a prepaid return shipping label. Once received at our fulfillment center, inspections take 2 business days.

title: Refund Rules and Approval Thresholds
content: Refunds up to $50.00 can be issued directly by automated support agents upon customer request for minor defects or shipping delays exceeding 5 days. Any refund exceeding $50.00 requires mandatory Human Supervisor Approval to prevent fraud. Approved refunds take 3-5 business days to credit back to the original payment method.

title: Damaged or Defective Item Replacement
content: If an item arrives damaged, the customer must submit photographic evidence or confirm package condition. The agent will create an expedited Tier-2 Replacement Ticket. The replacement unit is dispatched within 24 hours at no additional charge.

title: Weather Delays and Carrier Exceptions
content: If a shipment encounters an active carrier weather delay or logistical rerouting, carriers require a 48-hour grace period before an investigation is initiated. For packages delayed longer than 4 days past the estimated delivery date, agents may offer a $15 store credit courtesy discount.
